strategy: Hermit Druid -> Laboratory Maniac combo backed by a self-mill/delirium creature beatdown plan
identity: Green-Blue self-mill combo-midrange: Hermit Druid + Laboratory Maniac as an alternate win condition, with Splinterfright/Moldgraf Millipede/Ghoultree providing an independent fair beatdown clock off the same graveyard-filling core.

mainboard.name: Hermit Druid
mainboard.oracle_text: {G}, {T}: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a basic land card. Put that card into your hand and all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
mainboard.role: Combo engine: mills to a basic land, digs a land to hand; enables Laboratory Maniac win and fuels delirium/GY

mainboard.name: Laboratory Maniac
mainboard.oracle_text: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
mainboard.role: Alternate win condition: win instead of losing when drawing from an empty library
